description: This file implements the HttpRequest class, which handles HTTP request parsing, including extracting method, command, parameters, and post data, and provides a reply function to send responses.

classes.name: HttpRequest
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, providing access to method, command, parameters, post data, and a reply mechanism.

methods.name: HttpRequest::HttpRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpRequest object by parsing the connection and request info, extracting method, command, and parameters.

methods.name: HttpRequest::getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: HttpRequest::getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command part of the URI.

methods.name: HttpRequest::getParams
methods.description: Returns the URI parameters as a vector of strings.

methods.name: HttpRequest::reply
methods.description: Sends a reply message over the connection.
